title: Office Order No. A.2604/2026 dated 10/08/2026, regarding appointment of Officer on Special Duty, on order to work basis, in the Registry of High Court of Gujarat.

FULL TEXT:
No. A.2604/2026
OFFICE ORDER
The Honourable Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad has been
pleased to pass an order of posting of Ms. Mrunali Jigishkumar Kikani, Additional
Civil Judge and JMFC, Taluka Court Talaja, Bhavnagar, as Officer on Special Duty,
on Order to Work basis, in the Registry of High Court of Gujarat.
Further, Honourable the Chief Justice has been pleasedto direct Ms. Mrunali
JigishkumarKikani to report for taking chargeof the post on 17/08/2026.
By order of the Honourable Chief
Justice of the High Court of Gujarat.
